contentEn:
Most Vancouver homeowners underestimate how long a bathroom renovation actually takes. A realistic Vancouver bathroom renovation timeline runs from 3 weeks for a cosmetic refresh to 8 weeks for a full gut — and that is before accounting for permit delays, material lead times, or unexpected structural discoveries.

This guide breaks down each phase of a Vancouver or Metro Vancouver bathroom renovation so you can plan accordingly, set real expectations with your contractor, and avoid the most common scheduling surprises.

Phase 1: Planning and Design (1-3 Weeks)

Every successful bathroom renovation starts with a clear scope. This phase includes measuring the space, deciding between a cosmetic refresh and a full gut, and selecting materials. For Vancouver homes built before 1970, budget extra time for knob-and-tube wiring inspection and potential galvanized steel pipe replacement.

Phase 2: Permits (2-4 Weeks in Metro Vancouver)

Not all bathroom renovations require a permit. Moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural elements, or rewiring typically requires one. A cosmetic refresh — new vanity, tile, faucet — usually does not. When a permit is required, budget 2-4 weeks for processing. During peak renovation season, processing times can stretch longer.

Phase 3: Material Procurement (1-4 Weeks)

Material lead times are one of the most underestimated parts of a Vancouver bathroom renovation timeline. Imported tiles, custom glass showers, specialty plumbing fixtures, and engineered vanity tops can take 2-4 weeks to arrive once ordered. Standard finishes available locally can often be procured within days.

Phase 4: Demolition and Rough-In (1-2 Weeks)

Demolition typically takes 1-3 days. A full gut generates significant construction debris requiring proper Metro Vancouver disposal. Rough-in covers plumbing, electrical, and HVAC modifications. In older Vancouver homes this is where surprises appear: corroded pipes, outdated wiring, or missing insulation. Budget an extra 3-7 days for remediation if your home is pre-1970.

Phase 5: Tiling and Waterproofing (1-2 Weeks)

Tile work and waterproofing are among the most schedule-sensitive phases. Once tile is set, the waterproofing membrane beneath it must be inspected before final grout and seal are applied. Rushing this phase is the most common cause of future water damage claims in Vancouver condo and townhouse renovations. For a standard 40-60 sq ft bathroom, tiling typically takes 3-5 days plus 1-2 days for grout and seal.

Phase 6: Fixtures, Paint, and Completion (1-2 Weeks)

The final phase covers installing the vanity, toilet, faucet, shower head, mirror, lighting, and any remaining trim. Paint is applied after tiling is complete and the space is clean and dry. A skilled Vancouver renovation contractor can complete fixture installation in 2-4 days. Punch-list items and final walkthrough add another 1-2 days.

Vancouver Bathroom Renovation Timeline Summary

Renovation TypeDurationPermit RequiredTypical Cost Range
Cosmetic Refresh3-8 weeksUsually no8000-25000 CAD
Standard Update4-6 weeksUsually no18000-45000 CAD
Full Gut6-8 weeksUsually yes30000-75000+ CAD

These timelines assume normal material availability and no major structural surprises. Pre-1970 Vancouver homes frequently require additional time for knob-and-tube wire remediation, galvanized pipe replacement, or subfloor structural repairs discovered during demolition.

大多数温哥华业主低估了浴室翻新所需的时间。一次温哥华或大温地区的浴室翻新，美容刷新需要3周，全拆翻新需要8周——这还未计算许可证延迟、材料交期或意外结构发现的时间。

本指南详细分解了大温地区浴室翻新的每个阶段，帮助您合理规划、与装修承包商设定真实预期，并避免最常见的进度延误。

第一阶段：规划与设计（1-3周）

每次成功的浴室翻新都始于明确的项目范围。此阶段包括测量空间、决定是美容刷新还是全拆翻新，以及选择材料。对于1970年前建造的温哥华房屋，需要额外预算时间检查明线布线并更换镀锌钢管。这些老房子在墙壁打开后经常会发现隐藏问题。

第二阶段：许可证（大温地区2-4周）

移动管道设施、更改结构元素或重新布线通常需要许可证。美容刷新通常不需要许可证。需要许可证时，请预留2-4周的审批时间。在装修旺季，处理时间可能会延长。

根据温哥华建筑法规，浴室翻新若涉及管道工程或结构变更，承包商必须持有有效的BC省建筑商执照并持有相关管道和电气分包商执照。

第三阶段：材料采购（1-4周）

进口瓷砖、定制玻璃淋浴间、特色水龙头和工程石材洗手台一旦订购通常需要2-4周才能到货。本地可用的标准饰面材料通常可以在几天内采购。

第四阶段：拆除与隐蔽工程（1-2周）

拆除通常需要1-3天完成。全拆翻新会产生大量建筑垃圾，需要在大温哥华地区进行适当处置。隐蔽工程阶段涵盖管道、电气及任何暖通空调改造。如果您的房屋是1970年前建造的，请预留额外3-7天的修复时间。

第五阶段：瓷砖与防水（1-2周）

瓷砖和防水工程是进度最敏感的阶段。瓷砖铺设完成后，其下的防水膜必须在最终勾缝和密封之前进行检查。在大温地区的共管公寓和联排别墅翻新中，赶工这一阶段是日后水损索赔的最常见原因。对于一个标准的40-60平方英尺浴室，瓷砖铺设通常需要3-5天，加上勾缝和密封1-2天。

第六阶段：洁具安装、刷漆与完工（1-2周）

最后阶段包括安装洗手台、马桶、水龙头、淋浴头、镜子、灯具和任何剩余的装饰件。油漆在瓷砖铺设完成、空间干净干燥后进行。熟练的温哥华装修承包商可以在2-4天内完成洁具安装。收尾项目和与业主的最终检查通常还需要一两天。

大温哥华浴室翻新时间表汇总

装修类型工期是否需要许可证典型费用范围
美容刷新3-8周通常不需要8000-25000加元
标准更新4-6周通常不需要18000-45000加元
全拆翻新6-8周通常需要30000-75000+加元

以上时间表假设材料正常供应且无重大结构意外。1970年前建造的温哥华房屋通常需要额外时间进行明线布线修复、镀锌管道更换或在拆除过程中发现的底层地板结构维修。
